How to measure

  • Chest: Wrap the tape measure around your torso. Go underneath your arms, across your shoulder blades, and over the largest part of your chest. The chest measurement is usually the size of the coat. For a more relaxed fit, add 1 inch to the total measurement.
  • Over Arm: If your over arm measurement is more than 7 inches larger than your chest measurement, the over arm measurement trumps the chest measurement. In this case, your suit size needs to match your over arm measurement.
  • Waist: Measure around your natural waistline, keeping the tape snug but not tight. This is typically just above the navel.
  • Hips: Measure around the fullest part of your hips, keeping the tape parallel to the floor.
  • Inseam: Measure from the inside of your thigh (crotch seam) down to the bottom of your ankle bone.
